blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Local stocks rose on Wednesday as bargain hunters snapped up index heavyweights International Container Terminal Services Inc. (ICTSI) and SM Investments Corp. (SMIC), even as most blue chips fell. The benchmark Philippine Stock Exchange Index (PSEi) gained 0.68 percent, or 37.27 points, to close at 5,493.41, while the broader All Shares Index added 0.37 percent.
